_about: Corrections for feed events whose source gives a wrong or unusable place. Keyed by feed_id; applied by scripts/feeds/run.mjs before the location gate. Each entry names the page that says where the event is.

devpost:31529.reason: Devpost's location line reads 'iCode Shrewbury' (a venue); the event page says it is 'happening right here in Asbury Park, New Jersey' (oct05 audit).

devevents:https://iowacodecamp.com|2026-.reason: developers.events gives only the state, Iowa; iowacodecamp.com places the Nov 7 2026 camp in Ankeny, IA (oct05 audit).

devevents:https://www.eventbrite.com/e/m.reason: developers.events gives only the state, Georgia; the event's Eventbrite page places it in Morrow, GA on Nov 14 2026 (oct05 audit).

devevents:https://www.swiftsonicconf.com.reason: developers.events gives the state, Tennessee, as the city; swiftsonicconf.com names Loews Nashville Hotel at Vanderbilt Plaza (oct05 audit).
